result.answer: If the demo patient records system (Records Out) only needed the current placement, this case would close with nothing to send and no escalation (W1). The patient is already shown in WARD-C from the later 09:45 UTC transfer, so the current place is right. Only the WARD-B stay (09:20 to 09:45 UTC) would never appear in the history. Today Records Out keeps a full history, so a person is asked to add that stay as a past movement. All members agree the old transfer must never be resent, because it could move the patient back to WARD-B. The message was well formed and failed only because Records Out was unavailable (HTTP 503). Where they differ: Encounter notes that W1 describes cancelling and replaying the later transfer, while the plan adds WARD-B as a past movement and leaves WARD-C alone. Encounter finds the plan's way safer. Impact thinks a replay might show extra moves to systems that read Records Out, but says this is a guess Shutter cannot check. Changing the setting is only a draft for a person to review on the Site profile page. I cannot change it.

perspectives.view: The message parses against its schema, and the failure was the receiver being unavailable, not bad content. Under current-placement-only, the case closes with nothing sent.
WARD-B no longer holds as the current place but is still true as a past stay. W1's cancel-and-replay wording differs from the plan's insert-in-place, which is safer.
Under current-placement-only, readers see the right ward and only the history gap remains. A cancel-and-replay might show extra moves downstream (inference).

suggested_change.why: Setting Records Out to current state matches needing only the current placement. It is a draft for review on the Site profile page.
